How do you work with agencies?

The short answer is ‘extremely well’. We will integrate into your existing workflow, so you’ll feel from day one that we are part of your team. With years of experience partnering with agencies around the world, we can promise excellent communication, efficient project management, and results you’ll be proud to call your own.
What types of projects do you specialize in?

Earlier on the site, we said we partner with agencies that can't afford to miss and that we excel on high-stakes projects where execution can’t fail. Well, that’s true. Whether it’s a rebrand, marketing campaign, product launch, or something else, our team is the one you employ when you ensure the best outcome possible.
How do you ensure quality and consistency?

First, we’ll address ‘quality’. We are a team of two senior developers who share a real enthusiasm for always delivering the best work possible. Sure, we can work quicker when required. We can also work under pressure. But never at the cost of quality. We truly believe in that. Looking at ‘Consistency’, we feel that this is the real benefit of incredibles. Because there’s two of us working as one unit, we can maintain continuity and split work efficiently to keep even the most complex builds moving quickly.
Do you handle design as well as development?

We are primarily a development team, not a design studio. That said, we can absolutely support the full project by bringing in trusted design partners when needed. With our years of experience, we have assembled a network of skillful and reliable creatives that we can always recommend when required. Whether you already have an in-house designer, an external creative team, or need us to assemble the right people, we translate design direction into precise, production-ready code.

As mentioned, we are two senior and experienced developers: Antoine Wodniack and Olivier Guilleux. You can check out our individual portfolios alongside the incredibles portfolio to get a sense of what we’re capable of. As for the incredibles unit, there are no juniors, project managers, or subcontractors involved. You’re directly talking to and working with the people writing the code - us!
How is working with you different from hiring a freelancer?

There are many differences. The standout one is perhaps how efficiently we work together, as one team. On your side, the difference will be largely felt in how smooth and steady the project progresses. There will be no gaps and you’ll see that we are able to achieve much more as a team than two independent freelancers would be able to do. When you consider the fact that we can work successfully without constant supervision then we can only see our offer as a major advantage to agencies. That’s why we’re doing this! It makes sense and it works!
How do you integrate into existing workflows?

When we team up, you can invite us into your current processes and tools. We have partnered with many agencies around the world, so we would be surprised if we were not already familiar with your preferred methods. We adapt to what is most comfortable for your team, whether that means collaborating day to day with your designer, joining weekly check-ins with your PM, or fitting into your existing QA workflow. We have worked with everything from visual feedback tools to spreadsheets and email threads. As long as requests are clear, we will make it work and keep the process smooth.
We are available to take on new projects and can accommodate various timelines. Please reach out to discuss your specific needs and schedule.
Where are you based and what timezone do you work in?

We work well with agencies and brands around the world, and that means that we are extremely flexible when collaborating across different timezones - across Europe, the UK, the US, Australia, and beyond. We are based in France and operate on Central European Time (CET, UTC+1/+2), but we regularly adapt our hours to overlap with our clients.
How long does a typical project take?

Most projects ship in 4 to 10 weeks depending on scope. A focused landing page typically takes 4 weeks, a multi-page brochure site 6 to 8 weeks, and a complex creative site or product launch 8 to 10 weeks. We typically start new engagements within 2 weeks.

Single-project budgets typically range from 5,000€ to 25,000€ and above, scoped against your specific requirements. For ongoing needs we offer recurring engagements: Standard at 4,999€/month (shared capacity, one project at a time, one expert developer) and Extended at 9,999€/month (dedicated capacity, up to two concurrent projects, two expert developers). All recurring plans include unlimited requests and a dedicated communication channel.
Do you work with non-agency clients or only with agencies?

Both. While we specialize in agency collaboration — plugging into existing creative teams as the development arm — we also work directly with brands, startups, and studios that need senior development capacity without going through an agency.
Can you take over an existing codebase or only build from scratch?

We generally work with our own production-optimised codebase, refined through years of experience building high-performance websites. When required, we are also comfortable working within an agency’s existing tools, workflows, and codebase. However, we do not take over legacy projects to clean up, fix, or untangle existing technical debt.
What is your process for starting a new project?

The general process is this: enquiry, discovery chat to understand scope and constraints, written proposal with timeline and budget, agreement, then kickoff. We are typically in a position to begin a project between 1-2 weeks after first contact. During the project, we share work in progress regularly so there are opportunities to provide us with feedback continuously rather than single big reveals. This ensures all of us keep moving forward in the right direction.
